cases.name: Josefina Catherine "Josie" Cunningham
cases.about: Family members described her as a sweet little girl with bright eyes and a beautiful smile.
cases.narrative: District Attorney Mary Pat Donnelly said the child “died by an act of homicidal violence as a result of a sexual assault." Emergency crews were called by her mother to an apartment on Broadway in Rensselaer for an unresponsive child. Prosecutors say the little girl was foaming at the mouth.
